title: Family Friendly: Pac-Man/Stock Tank Pool/Fire Pit
description:
Whether you are coming to Franklin to explore or catch up with old friends or family, you have found your spot. 
Central Location:
- Minutes to downtown Franklin
- 20 min to Leipers Fork
- 30 minutes to Nashville. 

Key Features: 
- Stock Tank Pool (Open April - End of September)
- Family amenities: Pickler Triangle, Nugget Couch, and Arcade. 
- Fire Pit
- One car garage
- Newly renovated and professionally decorated.
- Every Bedroom and both living rooms have Smart T.V.s

The space
Every aspect of our 3 bed 2 bath home has been meticulously designed to give our guests a relaxing and memorable stay. 
- Large kitchen
- Spacious living area/Play items for kids. 

Sleeping arrangements: 
- Primary Suite - king sized bed and an ensuite bathroom.
- 1st Guest room - Two twin beds
- 2nd Guest room - 1 queen bed
